summary: I ported js by the version 3.3 guide. It touches only js's own files: Syntax_js.ts (145 lines), Naming_js.ts (22) and runtimeforms/js.ts (+88 -11). The three old components are deleted (734 lines) and the golden carries only js's lines. My final check was `npm run build` (exit 0), then `REGEN=1 tools/portcheck.sh sdkgen out js` with my hand records: it exits 0 and prints PORTCHECK js: PASS. No class is recorded as defect and no shared file was touched. The from-scratch run (SCRATCH=1) exits 1 by design. The guard for js passes 4 of 4, the guard and reader together pass 81 of 81, and the suite without the toolchain lanes passed 2630 of 2635 tests, with 0 failures and 5 skipped. js has no README example test and no lane, so I ran the examples by hand with node 24 against generated SDKs (my/runblocks.js). The tutorial, the root quick start run from the repository root, and every REFERENCE code block ran. On the new code, 24 of 24 programs ran in the default model, 17 of 17 in crud and 17 of 17 in basic-server. On the old code the figures were 24 of 24, 17 of 17 and 15 of 17: in basic-server the old client constructor, run live as written, throws because it gives no server tenant. A control with three injected faults was caught (21 of 24 ran, and the one fault inside a try block was counted). js is the nearest port to ts. Its own decisions are these: the entity name is a field (the table said js has no `name`; it does, at EntityBase.fragment.js:7). utility() is copy: false, which I ran: utility() returns the live object. listOf is left undeclared. The import is package-addressed. The interface needed no change.

guide_problems.problem: It says only that decl and public must be extended as ts's were. The guard also needs `bare: true`, otherwise findDecls skips a declaration with no parameter list. The guard's message ('name is not defined by the runtime's entity') does not say so.

The shipped js forms have `optional: () => true`. Once a provider exists, the negative control 'an optional parameter shown required' fails, and the guide does not mention it. A forms `optional` must read the page signature's `?`. Stream's action then needs an exception.
`node tools/before/gensdk.js sdkgen/ts <root> js default` fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND: the sdkgen path must be absolute.

Silent on two things a run by hand needs. The generated js SDK will not load without its peer dependency pino (LogFeature.js requires it); I installed pino and pino-pretty under ports/js/run. The js blocks mix require (CommonJS) with top-level await (ES modules only), so no block runs as a file exactly as written, OLD or NEW. I wrapped each in an async function.
Test mode hides constructor faults. OLD's missing server tenant throws only in the live constructor, which no lane executes. Section 6 says so in general, but the guide gives no way to check it.
The root sentence printed only after the lead language's quick start (ts) shows as ABSENT for every non-lead throw-style port. The guide could say so ahead.

unverified: No tool compiles the 182 changed blocks of the 21 variations: 45 tutorial, 19 rootquick, 118 reference. Only the three models I generated were run. The constructor options run only through `DemoSDK.test(seed, options)` and the separate live-construction check. The tutorial and REFERENCE were run through a node_modules link at the generated repository root, i.e. installed as the Install section says, not from inside js/. A reader must also place the blocks in an async function or an ES module, because of the require plus top-level await mix.
